label: What graph-based analysis merges
subgoals: Merge the worst arrival and the worst slew separately at each pin
Use conservative values for path-dependent derates
Read the result as a safe but pessimistic bound

label: What path-based analysis recovers
subgoals: Re-time a failing path with its own slews and depth
Compare its PBA slack with the GBA slack
Limit PBA to paths whose GBA slack is below a threshold

label: Using both in a flow
subgoals: Apply path-based re-timing to the worst paths at signoff
Account for the gap between the two when setting optimization targets
